rel.char_riku_hyuga.canon_neji.distant_c.history: Riku repeatedly trained around Neji and learned to take Hyūga fundamentals seriously; early sparring losses helped inspire Faultline Style.
rel.char_riku_hyuga.canon_neji.distant_c.current_tension: philosophical difference between extreme traditional mastery and Riku unconventional synthesis

rel.char_riku_hyuga.canon_hinata.distant.history: Distant kin who trained around the same clan compound; no immediate-family relationship is assumed.

rel.char_riku_hyuga.canon_hanabi.distant.history: Distant kin within the wider Hyūga training environment.

rel.char_riku_hyuga.canon_hiashi.clan_au.history: Riku received conventional Hyūga fundamentals but chose to make bōjutsu and Earth Release central to his own style.
rel.char_riku_hyuga.canon_hiashi.clan_au.current_tension: some traditionalists question why a talented Byakugan user refuses to center Gentle Fist

rel.char_riku_hyuga.char_kai.future_team.history: Both are freshly graduated and pending assignment. Riku initially expects Kai age to make him a burden; no later trust development is pre-resolved.
rel.char_riku_hyuga.char_kai.future_team.current_tension: skeptical of a five-year-old teammate until Kai proves himself

rel.char_riku_hyuga.char_mei_arakawa.fut.history: Known through the same graduating/assignment context; future disagreements are not pre-resolved.
rel.char_riku_hyuga.char_mei_arakawa.fut.current_tension: Riku tends to act sooner than Mei prefers

rel.char_riku_hyuga.pc_wei_tang.future_i.history: Wei is the intended Jōnin instructor only after the saved Team Fujin assignment event. Riku is interested in Wei weapon-control philosophy.
